upstream_heuristic.description: Candidate placements along the gap bearing are ranked by ground elevation; higher ground is treated as a weak upstream indicator.
upstream_heuristic.limitations: True NHDPlus flowline tracing is out of scope for v0.1. Elevation is only a proxy: on flat coastal plains (e.g. Louisiana) gradients are tiny and the heuristic is weak; tributary vs mainstem topology is not resolved.

rationale: Largest sensor gap lies along bearing 315 deg from the input river point.
Proposed station at 50% of the 25 km search radius along that bearing; EPQS elevation 13.0 m.
Higher ground is treated as an upstream proxy (documented heuristic); true NHDPlus flowline tracing is out of scope for v0.1.
